full_prompt_en: A square retro-inspired anime portrait shows a square-jawed man against a speckled teal and gold cosmic background. The head and upper chest fill the frame, with the top of his glossy black pompadour cropped by the upper edge. He turns slightly toward the right but looks back toward the viewer with narrow, skeptical eyes under sharply angled brows. Broad warm skin planes build the forehead, cheeks, nose, and long chin from peach, orange, rose, and small pale highlights. Thick dark sideburns frame the face, and a short tapered section of hair points backward behind the ear. The mouth is a restrained horizontal line, making the expression dry and self-possessed. At the lower left, a magenta jacket enters the frame, with a crisp cream collar and a bright orange tie at the center. The clothing is described in simplified blocks rather than tiny seams, supporting the larger shape of the face. Behind him, a mottled green-teal field is streaked with ochre vertical brush marks and dotted by scattered white, yellow, and blue stars. Some points become small four-point sparkles, while others are grainlike flecks. The background remains flat and fantastical rather than a deep realistic star field, and it warms near the left edge. Dark ink contours define the hair and facial profile, while short painterly strokes break across the illuminated skin and jacket. Light appears to fall from the upper left, giving the forehead, cheek, and nose bright angular highlights and leaving the right side in warmer shadow. The overall composition is witty and stylish, pairing a bold graphic likeness with a playful, color-splashed cosmic atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形复古感动漫肖像呈现一名方下巴男子，背后是布满点点星光的青绿与金色宇宙背景。头部和上胸填满画幅，光亮黑色高耸发型的顶部被上缘裁去。他略向右转，却用窄而带怀疑的眼睛从锐利斜眉下回望观者。宽阔暖肤色平面以桃、橙、玫瑰和少量浅高光搭建额头、脸颊、鼻子和长下巴。浓深鬓角框住面孔，一截向后收窄的发束从耳后伸出。嘴巴是一道克制横线，让神情干涩而自持。左下方，品红夹克进入画面，中央有清脆奶油色衣领与鲜橙领带。衣服以简化色块而非细小缝线描述，支撑脸部的大形状。身后，斑驳绿青色域带赭黄色竖笔，散布白、黄、蓝色星点。有些光点成四角小闪星，另一些像颗粒碎点。背景保持平坦奇幻，而非深邃写实的星空，左缘较暖。深墨轮廓界定头发和面部侧线，短促绘画笔触在受光皮肤与夹克上碎裂。光似乎从左上方落下，给额头、脸颊和鼻梁明亮棱角高光，让右侧留在较暖阴影中。整体构图机智而时髦，把大胆的图形性面容与俏皮的彩色飞溅宇宙氛围配在一起。
style_prompt_en: The retro anime rendering uses crisp dark contour design and broad, angular painterly planes. Warm peach and orange highlights sit beside saturated magenta, cream, and a mottled teal-green ground, producing a playful warm-cool clash. Focal forms are simplified into emphatic shapes, with precision reserved for eyes and a few expressive lines. Short dry brush marks and faint grain prevent the flat areas from looking mechanically smooth. Scattered tiny stars and four-point glints provide a light rhythmic countertexture behind a large near-black mass. Directional highlights are sharp on the main form, but the background color is diffuse and decorative rather than physically illuminated. The crop is close and assertive, turning a small palette of strong blocks into a graphic identity. The overall effect is jaunty and cinematic, combining mid-century cartoon exaggeration with vivid modern color and tactile paint.
style_prompt_zh: 这种复古动漫渲染使用清脆深色轮廓设计和宽阔棱角绘画平面。暖桃与橙色高光靠近饱和品红、奶油色及斑驳青绿色底，产生俏皮的冷暖碰撞。焦点形体被简化为强调式形状，精确细节只留给眼睛和少数表情线。短促干笔与淡颗粒防止平涂区域显得机械光滑。散落小星点和四角闪光在大片近黑体块后提供轻盈节奏性反纹理。主体形体上的定向高光锐利，背景色却漫散而装饰性强，不追求物理照明。裁切贴近而果断，把少量强色块变为图形身份。整体效果轻快而有电影感，把二十世纪中叶卡通夸张与鲜活现代色彩、可触颜料结合。
theme_en: A square-jawed spacefaring man against a speckled teal sky
theme_zh: 方下巴太空旅行者立于点点青绿色天幕前
name: Space Dandy
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
